name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All nine trials trained cleanly, but scores are hidden, so I can't tell which trunk or recipe is best. In the final round I spread bets across good-looking variants. Structurally, the pooling head looks weakest. It pools max, min and mean separately per channel, so it can't easily match each cell's height with whether the target has a cell at the landing layer (the max height under the footprint). That is needed to judge 'fills only target cells and seals no gaps'. A learned convolution with a kernel the size of the footprint sees every footprint cell's features together and can learn these comparisons. Plan: put this footprint-convolution head on (1) the r2c1 trunk and recipe, (2) the 2-epoch, more-samples recipe of r3c1, and (3) a 4-block trunk with the legal-action mask as input. Varying recipe and depth hedges against seed noise and hidden scores.
